question.question: What if Lake Chad stayed larger through the late Holocene?

events.title: Timed channels water dry fields
events.summary: Communities use seasonal channels to direct lake water toward fields.

suggestions.title: Lake Chad contracts to marshland
suggestions.summary: A long dry interval contracts the lake to marshland, reducing water available to the channels.
suggestions.reason: A marsh by 3000 BCE leaves too little open lake water for the timed channels described in 2400 BCE.

suggestions.title: Shoreline gardens track seasonal water
suggestions.summary: Gardeners adapt planting to seasonal shoreline changes while the channels continue to carry water.
suggestions.reason: Seasonal shoreline gardens can coexist with the existing channel system.
